div.div:
Unique codes without a read. createWarehouse writes the warehouse and its CODE#<code> guard in one TransactWriteItems, both attribute_not_exists — a taken code cancels the whole write (WarehouseCodeTaken). Codes are immutable and warehouses are deactivated, never deleted, so guards are never removed (ADR-0052 §2).
The group check is the first line of every resolver. StockKeeper and Admin read and write; a Seller or a customer token gets Unauthorized, reads included (ADR-0052 §3).
No stream. Nothing reacts to a warehouse change.
